scenarios.name: only adults add or change pets and care activities; a child can read them

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_pet_care__pets (id, name, species, emoji, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO app_pet_care__activities (id, pet_id, name, icon, schedule_type, interval_hours, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'interval', 12, ?)
INSERT INTO app_pet_care__pets (id, name, species, emoji, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE app_pet_care__activities SET interval_hours = 1 WHERE id = ?
SELECT p.id AS pet_id, a.id AS activity_id, a.interval_hours FROM app_pet_care__pets p JOIN app_pet_care__activities a ON a.pet_id = p.id

scenarios.name: any member, including a child, can log a care activity and it shows in recent_activity
